notes.text: English: The page continues a discussion of a question described as “locale autour de x”, contrasted with question 1 as global on U. It states conditionally that the validity of the proposed assertions would imply that sections associated with valuations of L/K having residue field K normalize the written subgroup isomorphic to T^{I(x)}; the subgroup is said to be nontrivial when the valuation has no centre on U. The author calls this consistent with the conjectures of § 2 and says that these might initially have seemed “hâtives !”. The final paragraph turns toward questions 1 and 2 and normalization/centralization questions. These are reported claims; no proof was attempted or independently verified in this reading.

English: No diagram or drawing occurs. H's display around the subgroup formula is editorial: the formula begins a continuation line of the running paragraph. The long curves associated with “de corps résiduel K” and “aussi” are insertion leaders and do not cancel the live words they cross.
